item.description:
# Within Reach Flat Media VR180 0.1.0 Beta 3
## 中文
主要修复：
- 修复macOS版本无法切换英文界面的问题； - 中文和英文现在可以即时切换； - 语言选择会在重启后保留； - 补齐菜单、工作台、进度、对话框和错误信息的英文翻译。
本版本不改变VR180 Geometry、编码器或输出质量。
## English
Key fixes:
- Fixed an issue that prevented switching the macOS app to English. - Chinese and English can now be switched instantly. - The selected language is preserved after restart. - Added English localization for menus, the workbench, progress messages, dialogs, and errors.
This update does not change VR180 geometry, codecs, or output quality.

item.title: 0.1.0 Beta 2
item.description:
# Within Reach Flat Media VR180 0.1.0 Beta 2
## 中文
- 修复大视频导入时界面长时间无响应； - Production Planning 已移至后台； - Mono 和 SBS 视频使用持续 ROI Renderer； - SBS H.265 不再生成逐帧 PNG； - 视频透明 MOV 使用持续流式 QTRLE，动态视频启用 `g=300` 时间压缩； - 改进进度、取消和 FFmpeg/FFprobe 子进程清理； - 降低动态视频导出的临时磁盘和内存压力； - 保持精确 50、60000/1001（59.94）和 60 fps 合同。
透明 MOV 为 QuickTime Animation/QTRLE，建议用于约 5–10 秒短透明素材。 长时真实摄影透明 MOV 仍可能非常大。HEVC with Alpha 不包含在本版本。
## English
- Fixes prolonged UI unresponsiveness while importing large video files; - Moves Production Planning to a background worker; - Uses continuous ROI rendering for Mono and SBS video; - Removes per-frame PNG generation from SBS H.265 export; - Streams transparent video to QTRLE MOV with `g=300` temporal compression; - Improves progress, cancellation, and FFmpeg/FFprobe cleanup; - Reduces temporary-disk and memory pressure for dynamic video export; - Preserves exact 50, 60000/1001 (59.94), and 60 fps contracts.
Transparent MOV uses QuickTime Animation/QTRLE and is recommended for clips of about 5–10 seconds. Long photographic transparent MOV files may still be extremely large. HEVC with Alpha is not included in this release.

# Within Reach Media to VR180 0.1.0 Beta 1
The first public macOS Apple Silicon beta converts flat images and video into fixed-position VR180 media.
## Included
- Project creation and reopening. - Flat image and video import. - Deterministic VR180 preview. - 6K standard and 8K recommended output. - 50, 59.94, and 60 fps timelines. - H.265 export with Fast mode and bundled libx265 fallback. - Transparent MOV export for compositing workflows. - Signed Sparkle 2 update checks. - Bundled FFmpeg 8.1.2 runtime; Homebrew and system Python are not required.
## Beta limitations
- Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later only. - No Windows package. - Projects are not guaranteed to remain backward-compatible with later betas. - Final media should be reviewed in the target headset and finishing workflow. - 8K production output requires substantially more time and storage than 6K.
## Integrity
Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The DMG and app are signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Exact FFmpeg and x265 source archives are provided with this release.
